LanguageData.TM_Cleave.description: Executes a powerful, sweeping blow that can strike multiple enemies adjacent to the target. As long as the gladiator has enough stamina, this ability works automatically whenever the gladiator performs a melee attack. Cleave chance is calculated from weapon mass - heavier weapons are more likely to cleave.

LanguageData.TM_Sprint.description: Activates or deactivates the sustained combat skill Sprint - greatly increases movement speed but causes exhaustion. Requires 30 Stamina to sustain and reduces stamina regen by 20%.
LanguageData.TM_Sprint.label: Sprint
LanguageData.TM_Sprint_I.description:
Activates or deactivates the sustained combat skill Sprint - greatly increases movement speed but causes exhaustion. Requires 30 Stamina to sustain and reduces stamina regen by 20%.
Activating sprint grants the user 10s of evasion (25% dodge chance) and 5s of adrenaline. Deactivating sprint instantly returns 20 stamina and applies 5s of +20% energy regeneration.
LanguageData.TM_Sprint_I.label: Sprint
LanguageData.TM_Sprint_II.description:
Activates or deactivates the sustained combat skill Sprint - greatly increases movement speed but causes exhaustion. Requires 30 Stamina to sustain and reduces stamina regen by 20%.
Activating sprint grants the user 10s of 35% evasion, 8s of adrenaline, and all friendly pawns within 5 cells 10s of 25% evasion. Deactivating sprint instantly returns 35 stamina and applies 8s of +30% energy regeneration.
LanguageData.TM_Sprint_II.label: Sprint
LanguageData.TM_Sprint_III.description:
Activates or deactivates the sustained combat skill Sprint - greatly increases movement speed but causes exhaustion. Requires 30 Stamina to sustain and reduces stamina regen by 20%.
Activating sprint grants the user 10s of 40% evasion, 10s of adrenaline, and all friendly pawns within 10 cells 10s of 30% evasion. Deactivating sprint instantly returns 40 stamina and applies 10s of +40% energy regeneration.
LanguageData.TM_Sprint_III.label: Sprint
